item.title: Will this become the golden age in American education?
item.description: The Dean’s List with Host Dean Bowen – The public education system has proven to be an abject failure and parents are demanding more choices. "As we celebrate National School Choice Week, we embark on what will be a golden age in American education supercharged by a belief that all families should have access to the educational environment that best meets their needs.”

item.title: “It’s the Sun, Stupid!” A dive into real climate science with Dr. Willie Soon
item.description: This deliberate, irrational silencing of climate scientists is one of the reasons the scare has persisted for decades. If we had a more open environment of questioning data, presenting new results, and properly analysing the alternatives—all basic practices in science that are unfortunately not adhered to when politics steps in—we could have killed the climate scare much earlier in its inception...

item.title: Why eating better has not produced better health
item.description: The Tenpenny Files – Most people believe they are eating well, yet feel tired, unwell, or stuck. This conversation explores how food was reframed as healthy while quietly undermining energy and metabolism, why cooking disappeared from daily life, and how reclaiming food literacy at home may be one of the most powerful steps toward lasting health...

Does the vaccine interfere with everyone’s DNA repair and immune system, Dr McCullough? How can I detoxify myself from the vaccine? What does Dr McCullough consider to be a good cholesterol level? Are low cholesterol levels harmful to your immune system?

item.title: Teenagers fix cars for single moms in Virginia and give them for free
item.description: The Hidden Lightness with Jimmy Hinton – At a Virginia high school, teenagers repair donated cars and give them free to single mothers in need. Guided by compassion and faith, students learn real skills while restoring hope, stability, and dignity. With quiet generosity and no fanfare, this program shows what happens when education, service, and community come together...

With millions at risk of losing support and states facing severe winter emergencies, partisan brinkmanship in Washington threatens food assistance, military pay, and aid for Americans struggling in the cold...

item.description: Unleashed: The Political News Hour with Chris Cordani – As America nears its 250th year, modern politics reveals a system driven by emotion, manufactured consent, and carefully crafted political avatars. From staged outrage to media-driven manipulation, voters are conditioned to feel rather than think.
